fusions.name: Churned Turf
fusions.desc: Stamps a ring of hooves around you, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and slowing each by 20% for 2 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Hurls a stone that deals 26 damage to the first enemy it meets. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Fresh Legs
fusions.desc: Restores 5 stamina a second for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Last Reserve
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 25 stamina. Once every 40 seconds. You gain 5% dodge chance.
